页面原文: Catskill Animal Sanctuary offers many unique opportunities for business partners to show their support while benefitting from our public relations and marketing. Businesses can sponsor events, establish ongoing partnerships, or offer employees perks like group visits, virtual tours, corporate memberships, or gift matching.Fill out the form by clicking “I’m interested!” to start our partnership. For more information, please call (845) 336-8447 or email info@casanctuary.org.
HTML href: mailto:info@casanctuary.org
Interested in an ongoing partnership with Catskill Animal Sanctuary? CAS welcomes major partners dedicated to making our mission possible and supporting our animal welfare, rescue, and educational programs. Contact us to learn more about establishing an ongoing relationship with the Sanctuary by emailing info@casanctuary.org or filling out the “I’m interested!” form above.
